title: Create color palette from uploaded photo
stageRationale: No spec exists at docs/superpowers/2-photo-to-palette/spec.md, and no docs/ tree exists on any local or remote branch. Feature work has no design yet, so brainstorming is the entry stage.

repoContext.runtime: React 19 + React Router 7 framework mode; index route prerendered to static HTML and served from GitHub Pages
repoContext.constraint: Production deployment is static hosting; there is no server-side runtime for uploads or image processing
repoContext.ui: Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn/ui primitives; toolchain is vp (Vite+, Oxlint, Oxfmt, type-aware check); package manager Bun
repoContext.entryRoute: app/routes/_index.tsx is the only route and owns filter state (ColorFilters) passed to FilterPanel and ColorResults
repoContext.colorData: app/lib/colors.ts exposes COLORS (664 name -> hex entries); app/lib/filterColors.ts precomputes hue and CIELab L* and exposes selectColorGroups
repoContext.swatches: app/components/ColorSwatch.tsx renders a swatch button and copies its hex via app/lib/copyColor.tsx
repoContext.persistence: No persistence layer exists (no localStorage, sessionStorage, or IndexedDB usage)
repoContext.tests: No test files and no test runner configuration in the repository

notes: Init stage only. Do not execute the brainstorming stage in this session.
